newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks end at unofficial record.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks end at unofficial record.

text.p: Mexican stocks withstood a late downturn on Wall Street to retain substantial gains and end above the 4,700-point mark for the first time ever on Monday.
Analysts and dealers said the relative absence of conflict following Sunday's crucial mid-term elections gave a second wind to domestic and foreign buyers who have been in the bourse recently.
Preliminary figures showed the leading IPC share index was up 73.33 points when the closing bell rang, or 1.58 percent, at a historic level of 4,717.93.
